The high level of spending that occurred during the Covid pandemic has not decreased to pre-pandemic amounts. This poses a challenge for the new government, which intends to halve spending on consultants. Since the new government took power, new contracts worth nearly £650 million have been awarded, including a deal with KPMG to train civil servants. A Labour peer criticized the widespread hiring of consultants, questioning their ability to contribute meaningfully to complex organizations in a short time.
